question: Which exact firmware addresses give the UI host MiSans-Medium 24/28 label styles, object flag add/clear and a correct lv_bar_create?
callsite_evidence: sub_C49F944 (lvx_theme_default_init) initialises 0x20109EB8 with constructor arguments (1, 0x18, 0) and 0x20109ED0 with (1, 0x1C, 0); the same position in the other 10 Pro firmware holds the 12-byte-stride neighbour objects.

Object flag veneers (LDR.W PC,[PC], literal targets equal in 3.101.036 and 3.101.043): library 0x1C028BD9 = add_flag at 0xc5892a8 / 0xcaa6a10 (the second table is the existing lvx_object_add_flag record), library 0x1C028C85 = clear_flag at 0xc587988 / 0xcaa61d0. Identification: lvx_page_title_create makes the back icon clickable with the 0x1C028BD9 veneer(icon, 2) where Band 11's matches call FW_LV_OBJECT_ADD_FLAG (sub_C38404C), and lvx_page_msgbox set-up calls the 0x1C028C85 veneer with 2 and 16 where Band 11 calls FW_LV_OBJECT_CLEAR_FLAG (sub_C3840D8).

The old lv_obj_set_hidden record (0xc5879b8, library 0x1C028D39) is neither of them: calling it as set_hidden(obj, 1) left rows drawn on Mirage 3.101.043, and calling the clear veneer by mistake for hiding did the same. It is not used by the UI host.
ownership_analysis: Style objects are firmware-owned, borrowed read-only through lvx_style_apply. Flag veneers take a borrowed LVGL object.
unsafe_assumptions: Static recovery only; Mirage results are emulator evidence, not device verification.
recommended_probe: Run the ui-gallery module on a Band 10 Pro and compare label typography, hide/show and bar rendering with Band 11.
